summary: Solves Handle COMP inverse-kinematics systems and outputs rotation channels for bones so attached handles move toward their targets.
key_concepts: Creates rx, ry, and rz rotation channels for each bone listed in Source.
Fixed bones identify branches or units that should rotate together during the IK solve.
Iterations improve solution accuracy at the cost of additional cook time.
Init and Preroll reset and stabilize the solve around the rest pose.
Max Angle Change limits per-frame bone rotation to tame drastic or erratic solutions.

key_params.name: source
key_params.note: Bone object names to solve and output rx/ry/rz channels for

key_params.name: fixed
key_params.note: Bones that should rotate as fixed branches or units

key_params.name: iterations
key_params.note: Solver iterations; higher values improve accuracy at higher cook cost

key_params.name: init
key_params.note: Frame where bones reset to default rest angles

key_params.name: delta
key_params.note: Maximum angle change per bone per frame

common_gotchas: Handle CHOP expects a valid Bone/Handle COMP setup; it is not a standalone rig builder.
Export the solved rotation channels to the bones to drive the IK result.
More iterations improve the solution but increase cook time.
Max Angle Change can tame erratic behavior but may make the chain lag behind fast targets.
Use the source-grab workflow carefully; non-bone objects are ignored, but missing bones leave no useful solve.
